title: PUCN Order — Docket 26-04017 (2026-07-09)

Commissioner Tammy Cordova

ORDER
The Public Utilities Commission of Nevada (“Commission”) makes the following
findings of fact and conclusions of law:
I. INTRODUCTION
On April 14, 2026, Tenaska Power Services Co. (“Tenaska”) filed with the Commission
an annual report, for Nevada Gold Mines, designated as Docket No. 26-04017, on compliance
with the renewable energy portfolio standard (“RPS”) for compliance year 2025.

I. SUMMARY

The Commission approves the annual report and finds that Tenaska has complied with
the RPS requirements for 2025 for Nevada Gold Mines.

Il. PROCEDURAL HISTORY

* On April 14, 2026, Tenaska filed the annual report pursuant to the Nevada Revised Statutes
(“NRS”) and the Nevada Administrative Code (“NAC”) Chapters 703 and 704, including, but
not limited to, NRS 704.7825, NAC 704.8877, and NAC 704.8879; additionally, Tenaska
requests confidential treatment of certain information contained in its Annual Report pursuant to
NRS 703.190 and NAC 703.527 et seq.

* On April 20, 2026, the Commission issued a Notice of Electric Provider’s Annual Report on
Compliance with the Nevada Renewable Energy Portfolio Standard.

* The Regulatory Operations Staff of the Commission (“Staff”) participates as a matter of right

Docket No. 26-04017 Page 2

pursuant to NRS 703.301.

* On June 26, 2026, Staff filed a briefing memorandum (“Staff Briefing Memo”).
IV. ANNUAL REPORT

Tenaska’s Position

1, Tenaska states it has complied with its portfolio standard for compliance year
2025, and requests that the Commission issue an order finding that (a) Tenaska has complied
with its portfolio standard requirements for compliance year 2025 and (b) Tenaska may carry
forward the amount of portfolio energy credits (“PECs”) associated with portfolio energy
systems and energy efficiency measures set forth on Line 6c of the annual report. (Annual Report
at 1.)

Staff's Position

2. Staff states that Tenaska is required to meet the RPS requirements that were set
forth in NRS 704.7821, and under the provisions of NRS 704.7821(1)@), the RPS requirement
for compliance year 2025 stands at 34 percent of total retail sales. (Staff Briefing Memo at 1.)

3. Staff states that Tenaska reports sales of 450,108 megawatt-hours (“MWh”) to
Nevada Gold Mines, accordingly, Tenaska is required to acquire, and ultimately retire, a total of
153,037 renewable energy PECs (34 percent) for the 2025 RPS for Nevada Gold Mines, and that
Tenaska states that Nevada Gold Mines will themselves retire the PECs in compliance of the
filing. (/d. at 2.)

4. Staff states that in the Order in Docket No. 25-04007, Tenaska’s 2024 Annual
Report, the Commission issued a directive requiring that Tenaska’s 2025 compliance year filing
include copies of invoices or other verification for each Nevada customer to support the claimed

MWh sales, and Tenaska provided this information as Attachment F to the annual report. (/d.)

Docket No. 26-04017 Page 3

5. Staff recommends a similar directive be issued in this docket, to which, to
complete the necessary verification of Tenaska’s RPS requirements, on behalf of Nevada Gold
Mines, for 2025. (Id.) Staff also recommends that the Commission issue a compliance item
mandating that Tenaska, on behalf of Nevada Gold Mines, file evidence of its PEC retirements
within 30 days of a final order in this docket, and that the evidence submitted for this compliance
shall include a summary of the certificate serial numbers retired. (/d.)

Commission Discussion and Findings

6. The Commission finds that it is in the public interest to accept Staff's
recommendations: to find that Tenaska has met its required compliance with the RPS for
compliance year 2025 for Nevada Gold Mines; to issue a compliance item that mandates that
Tenaska submit evidence for Nevada Gold Mines of its PEC retirements, as discussed herein,
within 30 days of the effective date of this order, including specific evidence of a summary of the
certificate serial numbers retired; and to issue a directive mandating that Tenaska provide
verification for each Nevada customer to support its claimed MWh sales with its 2026
compliance year filing, similar to what was filed in Attachment F of the Report.

THEREFORE, it is ORDERED:

1. The Annual Report filed by Tenaska Power Services Co., for Nevada Gold Mines,
designated as Docket No. 26-04017, is approved.

2. Tenaska Power Services Co. has complied with the renewable portfolio standard
for compliance year 2025 for Nevada Gold Mines.
